title: Common Reporting Errors
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. positions.as_written: Check that the conclusion answers the question in the request.
Check that the relevant negatives are present rather than assumed.
Check that every measurement and grade names its convention.
Check that an incidental finding is described as incidental.
Check that the conclusion commits rather than returning the decision.
- An incidental finding should be labelled as incidental.
